subject: [RFC PATCH v2 11/18] mm/filemap: mark a folio accessed in one place in filemap_read()

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the filemap_read() function by moving the folio access marking into a single helper function, filemap_read_accessed(). This function is called once per folio in the loop, eliminating duplicate code and making it easier to decide which folios are worth reading without a reference. The change does not affect the behavior of the function, but prepares for future improvements.
